name: clor
description: Give your coding agent claws, subagents that automate work in the background or on a schedule using the same MCP servers, CLIs, skills, and tools your agent already has, plus a toolkit for working outside the repo. Web research with search, scrape, parse, map, crawl, and screenshot, AI text, image, and audio inference across Claude, GPT, Gemini, and ElevenLabs, Hacker News reads, email over IMAP and SMTP, cloud files, encrypted secrets, weather, and bulk domain name checking.
